en: Herbalist
Hello, dear. Herbs are bitter, but they do a body good, and they cost next to nothing.
Mind your Pokémon pull a face when they take them. It means they're working.
Old Man
Psst! Treasures at a fraction of what the collectors pay. One to a customer, mind, and only today.
What will it be?
NUGGET  4,500
PEARL  650
BIG PEARL  3,500
STARDUST  900
STAR PIECE  4,600
NOTHING
A pleasure doing business. Not a word to the collectors, eh?
Your purse is a little light for that one, I'm afraid.
Suit yourself. These bargains won't wait for ever, though.
That's all I'll part with today. Come by again on a Monday.
Barber
Welcome! I'm the elder of the two barbers down here, and the better, whatever my brother tells you.
A trim for one of your Pokémon is 500. Shall I?
Which one shall it be?
{member:RESULT} is delighted with its new look!
{member:RESULT} looks pleased with its trim.
There we are. Come back another day and I'll do it again.
An Egg? There's nothing on it to trim!
Oh dear, that's not quite enough. Another time.
Another time, then.
One trim a day is plenty. Come again another day.
Barber
Welcome! I'm the younger of the two barbers down here, and the cheaper, whatever my brother tells you.
A trim for one of your Pokémon is 300. Shall I?
Which one shall it be?
{member:RESULT} looks a little happier.
{member:RESULT} looks pleased with its trim.
{member:RESULT} is overjoyed with its new look!
All done! I'm still learning, so every trim comes out a little different.
An Egg? There's nothing on it to trim!
Oh, that's not quite enough. Another time!
Another time, then!
My brother and I share one chair: one trim a day. Come again another day!
Grunt
Hey, are you one of the new recruits too? We took on a whole crowd for the Radio Tower job and ran short of uniforms.
text: Hei, ești și tu printre noii recruți? Am luat o mulțime de oameni pentru treaba de la Turnul Radio și am rămas fără uniforme.

en: The photo studio here keeps a rack of them for its pictures, so I'm helping myself. You'd better change too!
text: Studioul foto de aici ține un suport întreg cu ele pentru poze, așa că mă servesc. Mai bine te schimbi și tu!

en: {player} pulled on a Team Rocket uniform from the studio's rack.
text: {player} a îmbrăcat o uniformă a Echipei Rocket de pe suportul studioului.
